svg.title: Parent representative connects to the nearest object in a descendant attribute
svg.desc: A nonempty ancestor P connects over empty intermediate attribute X to object g in F nearest to parent representative rp. The gateway g need not be a representative. Frozen object-graph edges are bidirectional, distinct from taxonomy edges.

path.aria-label: 空中间属性上方的父代表点，连接到最近子对象网关
选择规则：g = argminₓ d(v(rₚ), v(x))，x 遍历 F 的全部直属对象；g 不必等于 r_f。
虚线为属性 DAG 路径；绿色双向边是对象图中的跨属性邻接。主合并边冻结，原始局部边不被替换。
